tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | REST APIs & Enterprise Integrations | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Software Developer PHP (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Spryker
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining Detlev Louis to help advance your enterprise e-commerce platform. With over 5 years of backend engineering experience building and integrating high-traffic e-commerce systems at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API integrations, scalable architectures, and agile delivery.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines and RESTful APIs connecting PIM, ERP, and MDM systems to ensure seamless multi-system synchronization.

bullets.label: Architecture & Clean Code
bullets.text: Applied robust design patterns, clean code principles, and database performance tuning to maintain high system stability and low response latency.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and automated unit testing suites to guarantee rigorous software quality and reliable platform updates.

bullets.label: Agile Scrum Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with cross-functional Scrum teams, product owners, and international stakeholders to analyse requirements and drive feature delivery.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce background aligns with your goals.

tailoring.why_company: Detlev Louis stands for innovation, quality, and a strong collaborative culture in the e-commerce space. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce development and integration experience to your Scrum teams, contributing to robust architecture, seamless third-party integrations, and scalable online platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce integration, API development, and agile delivery experience to scale Detlev Louis's digital platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I noticed your opening for the Software Developer E-Commerce role at Detlev Louis. With 5+ years of backend engineering and integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to discuss how I can contribute to your Scrum teams. Best regards, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Software Developer PHP (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Spryker – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Software Developer E-Commerce & Spryker position at Detlev Louis. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce backend development, robust API integration experience, and a strong background in agile Scrum environments, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your technical team.

I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
